$schema_note: Product/resource catalog for Hostinger, scoped to what this discovery round verified. `api_capability`/`mcp_capability` are per-resource summaries; UNKNOWN means no fetched official source confirms or denies it, never a guess.

compute.name: VPS (Virtual Private Server)
compute.notes: 62 MCP tools (VPS_*), covering list/get/purchase/start/stop/restart/recreate, firewall, snapshots, backups, SSH keys, metrics, DNS/PTR, post-install scripts.

compute.name: GPU Instances
compute.notes: Confirmed NOT a VPS plan type ('Unlike VPS plans... GPU instances are billed hourly on-demand'). hPanel-only setup and management; no API or CLI mentioned in either official GPU support article. Zero GPU-named MCP tools in the 365-tool inventory.

networking.name: DNS
networking.notes: 8 MCP tools (DNS_*): get/update/delete/reset records, snapshot/restore, validate.

hosting.name: Website / Hosting infrastructure
hosting.notes: 56 MCP tools (hosting_*): cron jobs, databases, subdomains, redirects, WordPress installs.

hosting.name: Agency Plan hosting (h5g)
hosting.notes: 38 MCP tools (agency-hosting_*): deploy node-static/PHP, datacenter listing, domain linking.

billing.name: Billing / Subscriptions
billing.notes: 9 MCP tools (billing_*): catalog, purchase orders, payment methods, auto-renewal.

ai.name: Hostinger Horizons (AI app builder)
ai.notes: 2 MCP tools (horizons_*). Uses nexos.ai internally as its model-orchestration layer — see related_products_not_part_of_this_provider in provider.json.

ai.name: nexos.ai (AI model gateway)
ai.notes: Separate product/domain, OpenAI-compatible per direct-quote evidence (see evidence file). Not part of developers.hostinger.com or api-mcp-server.
